atomic_facts.fact: Vijay Mallya's full legal name is Vijay Vittal Mallya.
He is commonly known as Vijay Mallya.
Vijay Mallya held a 1.87% shareholding in Kingfisher Airlines.
Vijay Mallya was listed as a promoter of Kingfisher Airlines.
Vijay Mallya served as Chairman of Kingfisher Airlines.
His chairmanship of Kingfisher Airlines began in January 2004.
The chairmanship is listed as continuing to the present (i.e., onward from January 2004).
